marginNotes: The station has a strong product mix including ultra-premium XP100 petrol, XP95, XtraGreen Diesel, and CNG. CNG is described as the highest volume, lowest margin product.
The station's success is heavily influenced by its location on the congested Pankha Road, offering high visibility but difficult conversion due to traffic.
The failure of the Janakpuri Flyover project has paradoxically preserved the station's prime frontage and access, which might be lost if the project were completed.
